newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines picks Salomons as yankee underwriter.
newsitem.headline: Philippines picks Salomons as yankee underwriter.

text.p: The Philippines has selected Salomon Brothers to underwrite in debut yankee bond, a Central Bank official said on Tuesday.
"It's Salomons," the official told Reuters, but asked not to be identified.
The Central Bank postponed the issue in April, citing poor U.S. Treasury market conditions.
The official declined to give any other details.
A Central Bank press conference is due at 11 a.m. (0300 GMT).
Five other banks also bid to underwrite the issue -- Citibank NA, Morgan Stanley, Merrill Lynch, JP Morgan and ING Barings.
All six banks had originally been selected to lead manage the issue in April, with Salomon Brothers heading the group.

The issue has been plagued by public acrimony among some of the original underwriters as well as domestic criticism in the Philippines where opponents have charged the government with unnecessarily adding to the country's debt burden.
The Central Bank argues that although it does not particularly need the money, the bond is necessary to set a benchmark for the country's state and private sector borrowers.
Last week it announced it had decided to reopen bids to underwite the 30- and 100-year issue and cut the amount to less than $750 million from an originally planned $1 billion.
